sources.source: https://github.com/mshumer/Claude-of-Duty — browser FPS, Three.js r180/WebGL2, ~55k lines across 11 subsystems, built by orchestrated Claude agents; 100% procedural assets (no texture/model/audio files); single-player vs AI soldiers — NO netcode anywhere in the repo (verified against full file tree)
sources.note: Read this session via WebFetch: repo page (1.0k stars), raw README.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, prompt.md, full git tree (recursive API), plus source files src/core/prewarm.js, src/ai/nav.js, src/ai/agent.js, tools/profile.mjs, tools/imagediff.mjs, tools/workflows/perf.js. All mechanisms and numbers below come from those fetches, not recollection. Caveats: (1) they use Vite — we have no build step, but every technique below is a runtime/tool-level pattern that ports; (2) prompt.md is thin (~941 B: 'build a CoD-level FPS, fan out sub-agents, harsh critic, loop until perfect') — the real process knowledge is in README's post-mortem and tools/workflows/perf.js, both read.

sources.source: https://x.com/prasenx/status/2081262380445847924 → t.co link → github.com/StarKnightt/operation-ironhold ("Operation Ironhold": single-file 290 KB HTML FPS, three.js r128 CDN, built by Claude Opus 5 from 5 prompts; repo includes PROMPTS.md verbatim, tools/test-harness.js, tools/autoplay-bot.js). Parent tweet: "built a full FPS game with claude opus 5 one HTML file. no assets. no build tools... 4 weapons with ADS, recoil, reloads; 10 AI enemies that flank, take cover, call out positions; sniper scope with breath holding..."
sources.note: x.com direct fetch returned HTTP 402; threadreaderapp showed only its login shell; nitter.net empty, nitter.poast.org 503, xcancel Cloudflare-blocked. Recovered the actual tweet via cdn.syndication.twimg.com/tweet-result?id=2081262380445847924 (full tweet text + quoted parent tweet), then followed the t.co redirect to the GitHub repo and fetched README, PROMPTS.md, tools/autoplay-bot.js, tools/test-harness.js. Caveat: file contents were read via WebFetch summarization of the real pages, not raw byte-level reads, so exact code lines are paraphrased; all mechanisms below trace to those fetches this session.

adoptNow.technique: Shader pre-warm before frame 1 (renderer.compileAsync with a bound render target)
adoptNow.target: C:\Users\TestRun\Claude Claw\forgeflow-games\pipeline\engine\runtime\3d\ffg_kernel_3d.js (+ ffg_boot3d.js / ffg_scene_boot.js) — inherited by all 3D games; highest value Last Circle and Colosseum
adoptNow.plan: After scene build and before revealing the game, enumerate every material the emit produced (scene walk + fx/decal/ragdoll pools), bind a small scratch WebGLRenderTarget, and run renderer.compileAsync(scene, camera) from 2-4 poses covering material/lighting variety; blit post/fx materials into the scratch target. Gotcha from source (measured): a render target MUST be bound during compile or three.js keys the programs to the unused canvas variant (25 of 47 wasted). Budget ~1-1.5s added to boot. Acceptance: renderer.info.programs delta = 0 during first combat (first muzzle flash / hit decal / ragdoll), asserted by the p99 gate item below. Verified gap: grep for compileAsync/prewarm across pipeline\ returned zero hits this session.

adoptNow.technique: Fixed visible-light pool (light COUNT is a three.js shader-permutation key)
adoptNow.target: Same kernel + emitted fx modules with dynamic lights (muzzle flash, explosions, torches): Last Circle, Colosseum, Thronedrift, Ember Sanctum
adoptNow.plan: Audit emitted runtime for runtime light add/remove or .visible toggles; replace with a fixed pool allocated at boot, parked at intensity=0 with visible:true. Source measured +33-36 program recompiles at 640-900ms bursts each time the visible-light count changed. Direct extension of the existing strip-GLB-lights / DPR 1.5 / shadow-1024 doctrine; pipeline-level per the never-patch-games rule.

adoptNow.technique: p99 + hitch-attribution perf verdict (median FPS hides unplayability)
adoptNow.plan: Extend __PERF__.getPerformance() to record per-frame ms deltas plus renderer.info counters (programs/geometries/textures); extend fps_verdict with p50/p95/p99 and hitch attribution: hitch = frame > max(2*median, median+8ms); a program-count jump co-located with a hitch = shader compile, texture jump = upload stall. Fail on p99 floor even when avg passes (source: 94fps static benchmark vs p99 4-9fps in real gameplay). Verified: current gate scores avg>=40 / min>=24 only, no percentiles, no attribution — this is additive to an already-tested deterministic gate, unit-testable with synthetic sample arrays exactly like the existing fps_verdict tests.

adoptNow.technique: Content referential-integrity pass (catches the Colosseum no-opponent bug class)
adoptNow.plan: After the existing schema-shape validation, add cross-reference checks: duplicate IDs; every bout/spawn/encounter reference resolves to a defined entity; every semantic clip-map entry resolves to a clip present in the GLB manifest; timing/range sanity. Colosseum's 6 champion bouts spawning no opponent is exactly this failure class — a dangling reference should be a loud blocking gate failure, not a silent no-spawn. Fits the existing learnings.jsonl rule that all content flows through one typed schema; verified this session that contract_gate.py validates shape only, not references.

adoptNow.technique: Honest placeholder fallback for unresolvable models (dev-visible, ship-blocking)
adoptNow.plan: When a model or clip fails to resolve at spawn, substitute an unmistakable placeholder preserving footprint, pivot, collider, sockets, and move timing; push one record to window.__FFG_FALLBACKS__. run_gates.py fails the build if that array is non-empty. Complements (does not violate) the No Primitive Assets rule: dev-time only, and shipping is blocked while any fallback fired. Second net under the referential-integrity gate for asset-side failures.

adoptNow.technique: Fixture + benchmark routes via URL query params
adoptNow.target: runtime\ffg_shell.js boot path + qa bots (boss_bot.py, playtest_bot.py, playthrough_bot.py); works with the existing _play launcher + __FFG3D__ hooks
adoptNow.plan: Fixture loader keyed off location.search: ?fixture=boss2 / ?fixture=lowhp jump directly into deep states (declared in the game's content JSON so the contract gate validates them); ?bench=1 runs one deterministic representative encounter then dumps a JSON snapshot (frame times, draw calls, triangles, renderer.info) via __FFG3D__. Gives QA bots minutes-not-hours access to boss phases in all 17 games and turns FPS-fix work into like-for-like before/after numbers instead of vibes.

adoptNow.technique: Bot-fairness combat constants: fire-token director + reaction delay + aim jitter + muzzle-block raycast
adoptNow.target: Shared combat AI module (pipeline\templates\shared / emitted enemy modules) — Last Circle bot fill, Colosseum multi-opponent bouts, Thronedrift
adoptNow.plan: Three drop-ins, ~100 LOC total at pipeline level: (a) director grants at most 2 simultaneous attack tokens, others reposition/flank; (b) 300-800ms LOS-to-first-shot delay scaled by distance and off-center angle plus ~0.018 rad aim jitter — the same two params double as difficulty tiers; (c) muzzle-to-target raycast refusal so enemies never fire through cover the player cannot shoot through. Melee analog for Colosseum: telegraph delay before attack commit. Constants lifted directly from sources as tuning starting points.

adoptNow.technique: Production playthrough deploy verification (prove the DEPLOYED game, not local)
adoptNow.target: C:\Users\TestRun\Claude Claw\forgeflow-games\pipeline\deploy_game.py, extending the existing curl redirect + hashed-asset checks
adoptNow.plan: After deploy, drive the LIVE URL headless: page load, first input, one core combat event asserted via __FFG3D__ hooks, console-error scan, plus the ?bench=1 snapshot; report deployed state separately from local readiness and record the rollback commit. Minutes per release; closes the exact stale-CDN/hashed-asset incident class we have already hit.

adoptNow.technique: Sequential single-owner passes for coupled systems + needsElsewhere reporting
adoptNow.target: C:\Users\TestRun\Claude Claw\forgeflow-games\pipeline\engine\v2_pipeline.py orchestration prompts / subagent report schema
adoptNow.plan: Process change, prompt-level cost only: when a build/fix touches a coupled cluster (lighting+materials+post, combat+animation), assign ONE agent the whole cluster sequentially instead of parallel per-file fan-out; add a needsElsewhere field to subagent reports for cross-cutting requests instead of out-of-lane edits. Source evidence: three rounds of 6 parallel agents = +0.46 critic score with defects rising to 66; one sequential unified-ownership pass = +1.00 and defects 66 -> 26.

adoptNow.target: Kernel actor update loop (ffg_kernel_3d.js) — Last Circle (up to 50 skinned Meshy GLBs), Thronedrift waves, Bastion Realms creeps
adoptNow.plan: Actors flagged off-screen evaluate skeletal pose 1 frame in 3 (_animSkip=2) with delta-time accumulated so the timeline stays continuous and there is no pop on becoming visible. Skinned pose evaluation is a top CPU cost in three.js crowds; trivial addition to the existing update loop, complements the DPR/shadow budget doctrine.

adoptNow.technique: Dynamic resolution scaling under the DPR-1.5 ceiling
adoptNow.target: Kernel render loop (ffg_kernel_3d.js), shared perf module — all 17 games inherit
adoptNow.plan: ~30 LOC: monitor frame time and scale renderer pixel ratio between a floor (~1.0) and the existing 1.5 ceiling to hold 60fps on weak hardware. Keeps the current cap as the maximum, adds graceful degradation instead of hand-tuning per game; the p99 gate provides the regression check.

adoptLater: Raycast-baked grid navmesh + A* + string pulling from collision geometry (zero authoring, fits no-build-step): required for Last Circle free-roam bot fill and richer Colosseum arena movement. Verified: only sim/tactical_grid.js has pathfinding today. Self-contained port but a real work item, not a bolt-on — sequence before the full bot FSM.
Full 8-state bot FSM with squad-level tokens (requestPeek/claimFlank) and hearing-updates-last-known-only perception — after navmesh lands; the adoptNow fairness constants are its down-payment.

Pixel regression gate for pipeline refactors + render-layer determinism contract (all randomness via injected rng, animation on engine clock, no per-frame allocs). Prerequisite decision: capture.py documents post-FX blacking out under headless SwiftShader, so the capture path must be settled first. Make determinism an emission rule in the next v2_pipeline touch so the gate is possible later — their retrofit cost was a 6-agent sweep.

Render-vs-reference vision gate: one packaged comparison sheet per pass, per-feature acceptance thresholds, blind A/B against 2-3 real benchmark screenshots of the same genre — extend fidelity_gate.py / ai_qa_panel.py; needs a claude -p budget decision since the vision gate is currently skipped in no-key runs.
Map-stripped (untextured MeshBasicMaterial override) silhouette check from 2-3 angles to catch hollow-shell/flat-card assets — batch with the vision-gate item above to share the claude -p budget.

userData runtime contract (sockets/colliders/destructionGroups) + GLB import-boundary normalization (forward axis, meters-per-unit, ground pivot, named sockets, semantic clip map) — codifies the ad hoc Meshy fixes (T-pose regen, Thronedrift palm sockets) into one loader-level contract; medium refactor of the asset loader.

Collision audit harness (tunnel/escape/ram/watch-maxStill stuck-enemy detection) + shot-registration fidelity test (ghost miss / false positive per weapon) in the selftest gate — cheap individually, queued behind the adoptNow gate work to keep this pass focused.

Per-subsystem preview harnesses + headless selftests for engine runtime modules (fx, actors, materials) so pipeline-fix agents iterate without full-game boots — extends the Tide Breakers selftest.cjs pattern.

Event vocabulary + ctx DI subsystem contract doc (canonical event names, surface-type vocabulary, hard per-subsystem budgets) as the agent contract — fold into the next v2_pipeline structural pass alongside the ARCHITECTURE.md that already exists.

Staged build passes (blockout -> gameplay -> art -> audio -> optimization) with per-stage acceptance gates + spec-before-code validated JSON (per game: entities/systems/asset list/socket contracts) — pipeline control-flow surgery; do when v2_pipeline is next opened for structural work.
Procedural SFX synthesis + generated convolution reverb in the engine audio module — extends existing procedural music; cuts per-game R2 audio weight and licensing surface.

Code-only procedural hard-surface prop factories (weapons, crates, arena props) to save Meshy credits and R2 bytes — ONLY behind the render-vs-reference vision gate; ungated primitive factories are exactly what the No Primitive Assets rule bans. Characters stay Meshy.
Selective procedural surface generators for stylized titles' ground/walls (Understone, Siegeheart) — source's own critics capped pure-procedural at 5.05/10; never for hero assets.
Single-file binned-SAH BVH for hitscan/melee-sweep raycasts — adopt only when the new p99 profiler shows raycast cost actually mattering.
Fragment-shader sky (magnification-proof) + ADS/gunfeel constants (0.2s settle, 40% ADS speed penalty, per-weapon zoom/FOV, 3s breath-hold) — when Last Circle gets scoped-weapon/viewmodel work.
Layered camera: base rig + temporary modifiers (lock-on, impact shake, occlusion policy) for Colosseum third-person melee — schedule with the next combat-feel pass; no open camera bug forces it now.

Vendor adapted MengTo SKILL.md game-dev skills (MIT) into the pipeline prompt corpus / .claude skills so every generated game inherits the same combat/QA/asset contracts — curation time, local copies already in scratchpad\mengto-skills\.
Hybrid asset decision table + per-asset provenance manifest (imported/procedural/generated-2D/reference + license) in engine output — license hygiene for the portal.
skipped: Full AAA post chain (MRT prepass, GTAO, TAA, motion blur, Karis bloom): source's own numbers show 28-30fps p50 at DPR 2 on Apple silicon AFTER optimization — cannot hold 60fps on our mid-hardware DPR-1.5 target; our kernel already has the worthwhile subset (AgX/ACES tonemap + UnrealBloom, verified in render_quality_gate.py markers).

Characters/weapons from geometric primitives (Claude-of-Duty and Operation Ironhold): directly violates the No Primitive Assets standard; Meshy auto-rigged GLB strategy stays — the sources' own critic ceiling (5.05/10) validates it.
Single-file inline HTML distribution: fights our hashed-asset CDN cache-busting deploy model for zero gain.

Mining Claude-of-Duty for netcode: verified absent from the repo (full file tree read) — the 55k-line FPS is single-player; our 9-game verified MP stack remains ahead. Recorded so nobody looks for it later.

Viewmodel dual-scene lighting: known-unsolved trap in the source (~20x irradiance mismatch patched by cheating albedo to one-third) — recorded as a warning if any shooter ever adds a separate viewmodel scene; nothing to adopt.
Video-to-superprompt capture workflow (MengTo codex skills): not a game technique; our engine generates from specs, and existing screenshot flows cover marketing-page needs.
Projection-first photo de-lighting/camera-matching (img2threejs v1.4 weapon update): solves photo-reconstruction, which no current or planned pipeline of ours does.

Scripts-enforce/model-judges token-economy split: already our doctrine — render_quality_gate.py and perf_gate.py are deliberately deterministic no-claude-p gates (verified in their headers this session); no action needed.
